name_input: INDIAN OXIDES AND CHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records (slug: indian-oxides-and-chemicals-private-limited) show the company as shipper on outbound bills of lading: "2026-01-31 INDIAN OXIDES AND CHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED TO THE ORDER OF PURCHASE MANAGER Antimony Trioxide (INDSTAR-RG)- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India New York, UNITED STATES 28258000 9263903" and "2026-01-29 ... Antimony Trioxide (INDSTAR-RG)- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India New York, UNITED STATES 28258000 9179651". Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 130 Records detected", "Trading Partners 12", "Ports 14", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-14"; the free view displayed 5 shipment rows (2 of them outbound exports to New York, US, HS 28258000, B/L 9263903 and 9179651, dated 2026-01-31 and 2026-01-29) — i.e. 5 of 130 rows visible, so the export count is a floor, not a total.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved for this entity: the web_search backend returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on both queries, and volza returned "fetch_error: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden". Domestic supply therefore not verified either way — null, not invented.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data (registered address on record: "SIR VITHALDAS THACKERSEY MARG, 3RD FLOOR, LIBERTY BUILDING", Mumbai). Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L entries, not by website claims: outbound Antimony Trioxide (INDSTAR-RG) to New York, US, HS 28258000, B/L 9263903 (2026-01-31) and B/L 9179651 (2026-01-29). Declared HS 281810;282580 — 282580 is confirmed by actual shipment records; 281810 (alumina) does not appear in the visible rows, whose other codes are 29331999, 81101000, 29039990 (inbound raw materials from DKS CO. LTD., AMALGAMET LIMITED, ICL TRADING (HK), QINGDAO RICHKEM). Per project rule 3, HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: keep the company, correct the code to the factual 282580 (plus inbound 81101000 antimony metal ingots, 29039990, 29331999), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer_trader — it both imports raw materials (antimony metal ingots, decabromodiphenyl ethane, flame retardants) and ships finished antimony trioxide under its own brand INDSTAR-RG, so it is a converter/exporter rather than a pure trader. Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts (130 total records) but no value or tonnage figures, and no public financials were retrievable. Domestic supply evidence: not found in accessible sources (search backend unavailable), stated as unknown rather than softened.
